segment_contamination_dimensions: Vehicle-mounted mobile toilet van buyers (sibling: Mobile Toilet Van, ID 44109) — buyers seeking truck/vehicle-chassis-mounted toilet units are a distinct segment from buyers of static prefabricated cabin units; any name implying vehicle-mounted or towed mobility is blocked.

Bio-toilet with biodigester system buyers (sibling: Bio Toilet, ID 119106) — buyers specifically seeking DRDO-based biodigester-integrated toilet systems are a distinct procurement segment; names foregrounding 'bio toilet' as the primary descriptor are blocked to avoid routing to that sibling.

Toilet cubicle and partition buyers (siblings: Toilet Cubicles ID 42587, Toilet Partitions ID 42587) — buyers seeking internal washroom partition fittings or cubicle hardware are incompatible with buyers of complete self-contained portable cabin units; names implying internal partition or cubicle fitout are blocked.

MS/steel portable toilet buyers (sibling: MS Portable Toilets, ID 189105) — while steel-frame variants exist within this MCAT, names that foreground MS or steel as the primary material descriptor risk collision with the dedicated MS Portable Toilets sibling; steel-primary names are blocked.

RCC and PVC toilet buyers (siblings: RCC Toilet ID 214584, PVC Toilet ID 222823) — names foregrounding RCC or PVC as the sole primary descriptor are blocked to prevent collision with dedicated material-specific sibling MCATs.

FRP Modular Toilet and generic Modular Toilet buyers (siblings: FRP Modular Toilet ID 126794, Modular Toilet ID 224049) — names using 'FRP Modular Toilet' or 'Modular Toilet' as the complete name are blocked due to exact or near-exact sibling name collision; 'modular' may appear as a secondary qualifier only.
